note: A `layoutGrow` that Figma itself ignores is no longer reported as a layout field the code failed to carry. Growth is shared out by an auto-layout parent; an export root's parent is outside the export, and a frame without auto-layout or a pinned child takes no part in it. An instance placed straight on the canvas keeps the 1 its component had in a row, and exporting it alone (the devup Test file's StatusCard and toast) was graded `lossy` for that value alone with `DEVUP_CODEGEN_LAYOUT_UNCOVERED`. The generated code is unchanged. The width-allocation proof for a filling child no longer fails on its row's spacing when the child is the only one laid out in the row: there is nothing to space, the code writes no gap, and the gap takes no part in the allocation. Where a proof still cannot be made it now names the actual obstacle - for a filling Text, its own minimum width - instead of `gap-mismatch`.
